verdict.rationale: First-party tracing docs say the SDK has built-in tracing that records LLM generations, tool calls, handoffs, guardrails and custom events during an agent run. They also say a Traces dashboard lets developers debug, visualize and monitor workflows, which covers every element of the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that traces appear in the dashboard as described.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace every LLM call and tool invocation of an agent run in an observability UI

citations.quote: The Agents SDK includes built-in tracing, collecting a comprehensive record of events during an agent run: LLM generations, tool calls, handoffs, guardrails, and even custom events that occur.
Using the Traces dashboard, you can debug, visualize, and monitor your workflows during development and in production.
